description: Adds groups. ListGroup holds a ListGroupHeader and a ListGroupRows; the header holds a ListRowSelect, a ListGroupTrigger with a chevron, ListGroupName and ListGroupCount, and a ListGroupAdd as its last item. The header is pinned to the top of the scroll area while its rows scroll. List adds expandedValues, defaultExpandedValues and onExpandedValuesChange; ← collapses a group and moves from a row to its header, → expands a group then moves to its first row, X on a header selects every row in the group and the header checkbox shows mixed while only some are, and Tab on a header moves to its add button.

Rows no longer share columns. Only the checkbox, ID and media line up down the list: the ID is 4rem to 6rem wide, the name 6rem to 20rem, and the description fills what is left. The facts sit at the end of the row in the order given, each as wide as its value between 2rem and 12rem. Adds ListPeek, a floating card under the peeked row that previews the item read-only, keeps focus on the row, moves with peek, and closes on Space, Esc or a press outside the list. List's context gains onPeekValueChange and rootRef. The item now depends on card.

Every column in a row is 8px apart, the related spacing token: the ID, the media, the description and each fact were 12px, 8px, 12px and 16px apart. ListRowPeek shows a tooltip, Peek · Space, that names it and its key. In a ListRowLoading, ListRowId, ListRowName and ListRowFact size their bar to the sample values you pass as children, so the columns keep their widths when the loaded rows replace the loading ones.

A focused or peeked row draws the same mark: the foreground at 4%, as on hover, and a 1px inset ring in the ring colour at 40%. The name no longer underlines on focus, and a peeked row no longer draws a 2px foreground ring at 15% or a 7% tint.

Rows have no line between them: the hover, focus and peek tints mark a row, and the tint takes the floor radius (6px). The selection checkbox and peek button take the floor radius in place of rounded-md. A List draws no surface; its rows sit on the page. A selected row is tinted with the foreground at 4%, 7% under the pointer, and a peeked row adds a 2px inset ring at 15%, as a peeked table row does.

Renames the item from record-list to list: RecordList is List, useRecordList is useList, and every RecordRow part is ListRow, such as ListRowLink and ListRowFact. Install it with the name list and import it from @/components/list.

The docs say media drawn alone, such as a status dot, needs a PreviewCard that shows its word, and peek or the item's page to reach it by keyboard. The default media's child fills the 24×24px slot, so a card trigger in it takes the whole slot as its hover target.

Renames the row parts to plain words: RecordRowIdentify is RecordRowSubject, RecordRowRead is RecordRowFact, RecordRowKey is RecordRowId and RecordRowGlyph is RecordRowMedia. RecordRowMedia adds variant icon, one 16px muted icon with no fill, named by its required label; a loading row draws it as a 16px block. RecordRowFact adds missing (unavailable or hidden), which replaces the removed field-state item.
Includes every RecordRow part, which the removed record-row item used to ship: import RecordRow, RecordRowLink and the other parts from @/components/record-list.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/components/record-list.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta. Its design critique is not yet clean: the status shows as a dot with no visible word (issue #44).
Installs into your components folder, so import it from @/components.
Merges class names with the cn item, so a className override replaces a token utility.
